name: Paperless-GPT
description: paperless-gpt seamlessly pairs with paperless-ngx to generate AI-powered document titles and tags, saving you hours of manual sorting. While other tools may offer AI chat features, paperless-gpt stands out by supercharging OCR with LLMs-ensuring high accuracy, even with tricky scans. If you’re craving next-level text extraction and effortless document organization, this is your solution. Description of container variables: https://github.com/icereed/paperless-gpt?tab=readme-ov-file#configuration

variables.name: PAPERLESS_BASE_URL
variables.description: URL of your paperless-ngx instance (e.g. http://paperless-ngx:8000).

variables.name: PAPERLESS_API_TOKEN
variables.description: API token for paperless-ngx. Generate one in paperless-ngx admin.

variables.name: PAPERLESS_PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: Public URL for Paperless (if different from PAPERLESS_BASE_URL).

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID to run the container as. See Documentation (Running as a Non-Root User).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID to run the container as. See Documentation (Running as a Non-Root User).

variables.name: MANUAL_TAG
variables.description: Tag for manual processing.

variables.name: AUTO_TAG
variables.description: Tag for auto processing.

variables.name: AUTO_TAG_COMPLETE
variables.description: Tag added to documents after auto-processing is complete. Only applied during auto-processing, not manual review. Set to an empty string to disable. When the variable is unset, the default tag (paperless-gpt-auto-complete) is used.

variables.name: LLM_PROVIDER
variables.description: AI backend (openai or ollama).

variables.name: LLM_MODEL
variables.description: AI model name, e.g. gpt-4o, gpt-3.5-turbo, deepseek-r1:8b.

variables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
variables.description: OpenAI API key (required if using OpenAI).

variables.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
variables.description: OpenAI base URL (optional, if using a custom OpenAI compatible service like LiteLLM).

variables.name: LLM_LANGUAGE
variables.description: Likely language for documents (e.g. English).

variables.name: OLLAMA_HOST
variables.description: Ollama server URL (e.g. http://host.docker.internal:11434).

variables.name: OLLAMA_THINK
variables.description: (Ollama only) Set to false to disable Ollama reasoning ('think') mode, true to force it on. Recommended false for thinking-mode models (e.g. Qwen 3, Gemma 3) on tasks that need strict output formats — with thinking left on, these models can spend the whole token budget reasoning and return empty content. If unset, the model's default applies.

variables.name: OCR_PROVIDER
variables.description: OCR provider to use (llm, azure, or google_docai).

variables.name: VISION_LLM_PROVIDER
variables.description: (for OCR) - openai or ollama

variables.name: VISION_LLM_MODEL
variables.description: (for OCR) - minicpm-v (ollama example), gpt-4o (for openai), etc.

variables.name: AZURE_DOCAI_ENDPOINT
variables.description: Azure Document Intelligence endpoint. Required if OCR_PROVIDER is azure.

variables.name: AZURE_DOCAI_KEY
variables.description: Azure Document Intelligence API key. Required if OCR_PROVIDER is azure.

variables.name: AZURE_DOCAI_MODEL_ID
variables.description: Azure Document Intelligence model ID. Optional if using azure provider.

variables.name: AZURE_DOCAI_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
variables.description: Azure Document Intelligence timeout in seconds.

variables.name: GOOGLE_PROJECT_ID
variables.description: Google Cloud project ID. Required if OCR_PROVIDER is google_docai.

variables.name: GOOGLE_LOCATION
variables.description: Google Cloud region (e.g. us, eu). Required if OCR_PROVIDER is google_docai.

variables.name: GOOGLE_PROCESSOR_ID
variables.description: Document AI processor ID. Required if OCR_PROVIDER is google_docai.

variables.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
variables.description: Path to the mounted Google service account key. Required if OCR_PROVIDER is google_docai.

variables.name: AUTO_OCR_TAG
variables.description: Tag for automatically processing docs with OCR.

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Application log level (info, debug, warn, error).

variables.name: AUTO_GENERATE_TITLE
variables.description: Generate titles automatically if paperless-gpt-auto is used. Default: true.

variables.name: AUTO_GENERATE_TAGS
variables.description: Generate tags automatically if paperless-gpt-auto is used. Default: true.

variables.name: AUTO_GENERATE_CORRESPONDENTS
variables.description: Generate correspondents automatically if paperless-gpt-auto is used. Default: true.

variables.name: AUTO_GENERATE_CREATED_DATE
variables.description: Generate the created dates automatically if paperless-gpt-auto is used.

variables.name: OCR_LIMIT_PAGES
variables.description: Limit the number of pages for OCR. Set to 0 for no limit.

variables.name: TOKEN_LIMIT
variables.description: Maximum tokens allowed for prompts/content. Set to 0 to disable limit. Useful for smaller LLMs.

variables.name: CORRESPONDENT_BLACK_LIST
variables.description: A comma-separated list of names to exclude from the correspondents suggestions. Example: John Doe, Jane Smith.
